svg.title: Binit is ready sooner than Bash-it and Oh My Bash, and later than a plain .bashrc
svg.desc: Binit is ready sooner than Bash-it and Oh My Bash, and later than a plain .bashrc. A new shell loading the same 50 plugins. Binit is scored against Bash-it and Oh My Bash; load=wait and a plain .bashrc with no manager are reported. Ready to type: Binit 22.4 ms, Binit, load=wait 27.2 ms, Bash-it 31.2 ms, Oh My Bash 69.8 ms, Plain .bashrc 14.0 ms. All 50 plugins loaded: Binit 33.1 ms, Binit, load=wait 38.2 ms, Bash-it 42.4 ms, Oh My Bash 88.3 ms, Plain .bashrc 22.4 ms. Binit 0.1.0 on one Linux machine: Ryzen 7 7800X3D, GNU Bash 5.3.20.
